query_text: Anti-PD-1 immunotherapy produces objective responses in patients with advanced solid tumors.
evidence_sentences: Blockade of programmed death-1 (PD-1) with monoclonal antibodies produces objective clinical responses in patients with advanced melanoma, non-small-cell lung cancer, and renal-cell cancer. Anti-PD-1 therapy demonstrated an objective response rate of 18% to 28% across solid tumor types.

query_text: Monoclonal antibody CB6 neutralizes SARS-CoV-2 by competing with ACE2 binding site.
evidence_sentences: The receptor-binding domain (RBD) of the SARS-CoV-2 spike protein is the primary target for neutralizing antibodies. Monoclonal antibody CB6 inhibits SARS-CoV-2 infection by recognizing an epitope that overlaps with the angiotensin-converting enzyme 2 (ACE2) binding site, effectively preventing viral attachment.

query_text: Cas9 requires conformational activation of HNH and RuvC domains for target DNA cleavage.
evidence_sentences: Cas9 is an RNA-guided endonuclease that uses a single guide RNA to direct sequence-specific double-stranded DNA cleavage. Structural studies reveal that conformational rearrangement upon guide RNA binding is required to activate the HNH and RuvC nuclease domains for phosphodiester bond hydrolysis.

query_text: Asymmetric distance computation in product quantization yields higher recall than symmetric computation.
evidence_sentences: Product quantization partitions high-dimensional vectors into orthogonal subspaces, allowing sub-vector quantization with small codebooks. Asymmetric distance computation computes exact distance from uncompressed query vector to quantized codebook centroids, achieving higher ANN recall than symmetric distance computation.

query_text: HNSW searches multi-layer proximity graphs starting from the sparsest top layer to achieve logarithmic complexity.
evidence_sentences: HNSW graphs organize multi-layer proximity graphs with exponentially decreasing edge density. The search begins at the topmost sparse layer with greedy search, proceeding down to the zero layer to discover nearest neighbors with logarithmic time complexity.
